info.name: FBR Middleware (SAP -> PRAL)
info.description:
Calls to the FastAPI middleware that sits between SAP and PRAL Digital Invoicing.

Set the collection variables: `baseUrl`, `apiKey`, `devToken` (sandbox PRAL token), `prdToken` (production PRAL token), `erpInvoiceNo`. Against the local mock PRAL any token except `bad` works.

## Request

`POST {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/{env}/invoices` where `env` is `dev` (PRAL sandbox) or `prd` (PRAL production).

Headers (both required, 401 otherwise):

| Header | Value |
|---|---|
| `X-API-Key` | key issued by the middleware (`MIDDLEWARE_API_KEYS`) |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <PRAL token>` for the chosen environment (ABAP reads it from ZFBR_TOKEN by SELLER_NTN + ENV) |

Body (envelope):

| Field | Type | Required | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `erpInvoiceNo` | string 1-50 | yes | SAP billing document; idempotency key per environment |
| `sellerNtn` | string | yes | 7-digit NTN or 13-digit CNIC; must equal `invoice.sellerNTNCNIC` |
| `callbackRef` | string <=100 | no | echoed back unchanged |
| `invoice` | object | yes | PRAL payload (header + items), see the sample body |

Conditional rules enforced before anything is stored (422 with `detail[].field`):
`buyerNTNCNIC` required when `buyerRegistrationType` is `Registered` and must differ from the seller;
`invoiceRefNo` required (22 or 28 chars) for `Debit Note`, must be empty for `Sale Invoice`;
`scenarioId` (SN001..SN028) required on `dev`, ignored/stripped on `prd`;
`hsCode` matches `^\d{4}\.\d{4}$`; `quantity` > 0; money fields >= 0 with 2 decimals;
`salesTaxWithheldAtSource` is 0 or equal to `salesTaxApplicable`; `invoiceDate` is YYYY-MM-DD and not in the future.
Unknown keys are rejected.

## Response

Envelope with `status` -> HTTP: SUBMITTED 201, replayed 200, REJECTED_LOCAL / REJECTED_FBR 422,
FAILED_UPSTREAM / AUTH_ERROR 502, UNKNOWN 504. `pralResponse` is PRAL's body verbatim; `errorDescriptions`
explains each PRAL `errorCode`. `X-Tracking-Id` header = `trackingId`.

request.description: Liveness, DB check, in-flight count and the PRAL URLs behind /api/v1/dev and /api/v1/prd. No auth.

item.name: dev (PRAL sandbox)
item.description: Routes to validateinvoicedata_sb / postinvoicedata_sb. scenarioId is required. Uses {{devToken}}.

header.description: PRAL Bearer token for this environment, from ZFBR_TOKEN

request.description: Local rules + PRAL validateinvoicedata only. Nothing is posted, no FBR number, nothing stored; a later submit with the same erpInvoiceNo is not a replay.
